title: Marketing sessions job hash must exclude modifiers the insert SQL ignores
answers: Why does marketing attribution fall back to live calculation despite cached sessions?
Session precompute job hash differs between writer and reader
cookielessTrafficIsRegular cache key mismatch in marketing analytics
body:
The session job hash for the marketing sessions dimensional precompute is built from `cache_key_context` in `ensure_marketing_sessions_precomputed` (products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/marketing_sessions_precompute.py).
It serializes modifiers with `model_dump_json(exclude_none=True, exclude={"cookielessTrafficIsRegular"})`.
Reason: the insert SQL (`SESSIONS_INSERT_TEMPLATE`) does not classify traffic types, and that rollout flag can resolve differently in writer (background) and reader (query) workers. If it is in the hash, the reader misses the cache and silently falls back to live calc.
Only modifiers that don't affect the insert SQL may be excluded. Other modifiers, channel rules and classifier versions must still invalidate jobs.
If a new modifier is resolved per-worker/flag but doesn't change the insert SQL, exclude it the same way.
applies: Marketing analytics session precompute cache identity (writer and reader must compute identical hash).
says: Attribution falls back to live calculation despite precomputed sessions
Session cache hit rate drops when cookieless traffic flag changes
Precompute job hash differs between background writer and reader
Why am I not getting cached marketing attribution results anymore
Session cache mismatch between simultaneous background and foreground workers
